Quality-control settings

Source: R/qc_config.R
qc_config.Rd

Build the set of quality-control (QC) thresholds used by the whole pipeline. Start from a preset with profile and override any parameter through ....

qc_config(profile = c("casey", "national", "legacy"), ...)

Arguments

profile

Preset to start from:

  • "casey" (default): feeder error criteria of Casey et al. (2005), robust regression (MASS::rlm) for body weight outliers and a quadratic growth curve.

  • "national": LOESS-based weight cleaning and growth curve, a minimum curve R², longer test period and lower missing rate.

  • "legacy": STL + robust regression + robust SD outlier detection and a Gompertz growth curve.

...

Parameters to override, as name = value. See Parameters.

Value

An object of class ppt_qc: a named list of parameters with the preset name in attribute "profile".

Parameters

Station transfer (pigs seen at several stations)

  • max_gap_days: maximum gap between two stations to treat the pig as transferred. A larger gap splits it into two animals. Default 3.

  • max_overlap_days: maximum time overlap between two stations. A larger overlap is treated as transponder misreads. Default 1.

  • max_jump_kg: body weight jump at the transfer that triggers a warning. Default 10.

Body weight records

  • weight_range: valid body weight of a single record, kg.

  • weight_outlier: one or more of "rlm", "loess", "stl", "sd".

  • outlier_combine: "any" (outlier for any method) or "majority".

  • rlm_cutoff: records with a robust regression weight below this are outliers. Default 0.5.

  • sd_max: residuals beyond this many robust SDs (MAD) are outliers.

  • loess_span: smoothing span for LOESS. Default 0.75.

  • rel_dev_max: optional, relative deviation from the curve above which a record is an outlier (e.g. 0.25). NULL = off.

  • daily_drop_min: optional, a day whose weight is below this ratio of the previous day is an outlier (e.g. 0.90). NULL = off.

Pig-level checks

  • min_test_days, min_records: minimum test length (days) and number of valid weight records.

  • max_missing_rate: maximum share of days without a valid weight.

  • entry_weight_max, exit_weight_min: maximum entry and minimum exit body weight, kg.

  • curve_r2_min: optional, pigs whose growth curve R² is below this are flagged as low confidence (not removed). NULL = off.

Growth and ADG

  • stage_range: body weight interval for ADG and FCR, kg.

  • curve_model: "poly1", "poly2", "poly3", "loess" or "gompertz" (falls back to "poly2" when it does not converge).

  • max_extrap_days: maximum extrapolation of the curve, days.

Feeder errors (Casey et al. 2005, Table 3)

  • fiv_range: FIV-lo / FIV-hi, feed intake per visit, g.

  • fiv0_abs_max: FIV-0, maximum |FIV| for a 0 s visit, g.

  • duration_max: OTV-hi, maximum occupation time per visit, s.

  • speed_fiv_lo_max: FRV-hi-FIV-lo, maximum feeding rate for visits with 0 < FIV < 50 g, g/min.

  • speed_strict_max: FRV-hi-strict, maximum feeding rate when the preceding or following visit has FIV < -20 g, g/min.

  • speed_range: FRV-lo and FRV-hi, g/min.

  • idle_duration_max: FRV-0, maximum occupation time with no intake, s.

  • trough_diff_range: LWD / FWD, trough weight difference between subsequent visits, g.

  • max_unidentified_feed_kg: feed disappearance in unidentified visits per feeder above which a warning is given.

Daily feed intake

  • dfi_range: valid daily feed intake, kg.

  • dfi_quantile: optional, lower and upper quantile cut-offs (e.g. c(0.025, 0.99)). NULL = off.

  • dfi_correct: "lmm" (Jiao et al. 2014) or "none".

  • impute_method: "linear" (linear interpolation, LOESS for long gaps, intake ~ body weight regression at the stage ends) or "loess" (robust LOESS over days everywhere).

  • long_gap_days: inside gaps longer than this many days are imputed with LOESS instead of a straight line (impute_method = "linear"). Default 7.

Confidence flags (used by calc_fcr())

  • max_edge_extrap_days: a pig is "low_confidence" when the growth curve or the feed intake is extrapolated over more than this many days at the start or the end of the stage. Default 15.

  • min_coverage: minimum share of stage days with recorded feed intake. Default 0.7.

References

Casey, D. S., Stern, H. S., & Dekkers, J. C. M. (2005). Identification of errors and factors associated with errors in data from electronic swine feeders. Journal of Animal Science, 83, 969-982.

Jiao, S., Maltecca, C., Gray, K. A., & Cassady, J. P. (2014). Feed intake, average daily gain, feed efficiency, and real-time ultrasound traits in Duroc pigs: I. Journal of Animal Science, 92, 2377-2386.

Examples

# Default preset
qc <- qc_config()
qc$duration_max
#> [1] 3600

# Another preset with one parameter overridden
qc_national <- qc_config("national", min_test_days = 50)
qc_national
#> 
#> ── QC settings: profile "national" ──
#> 
#> Station transfer
#>   max_gap_days: 3
#>   max_overlap_days: 1
#>   max_jump_kg: 10
#> Body weight records
#>   weight_range: 25, 140
#>   weight_outlier: loess
#>   outlier_combine: any
#>   rlm_cutoff: 0.5
#>   sd_max: 3
#>   loess_span: 0.75
#>   rel_dev_max: NULL (off)
#>   daily_drop_min: NULL (off)
#> Pig-level checks
#>   min_test_days: 50
#>   min_records: 20
#>   max_missing_rate: 0.15
#>   entry_weight_max: 65
#>   exit_weight_min: 85
#>   curve_r2_min: 0.99
#> Growth and ADG
#>   stage_range: 30, 120
#>   curve_model: loess
#>   max_extrap_days: 30
#> Feeder errors
#>   fiv_range: -20, 2000
#>   fiv0_abs_max: 20
#>   duration_max: 3600
#>   speed_fiv_lo_max: 500
#>   speed_strict_max: 110
#>   speed_range: 2, 170
#>   idle_duration_max: 500
#>   trough_diff_range: -20, 1800
#>   max_unidentified_feed_kg: 90
#> Daily feed intake
#>   dfi_range: 0, 6
#>   dfi_quantile: NULL (off)
#>   dfi_correct: lmm
#>   impute_method: loess
#>   long_gap_days: 7
#> Confidence flags
#>   max_edge_extrap_days: 15
#>   min_coverage: 0.7

# Optional rules are off (NULL) unless switched on
qc_config("casey", daily_drop_min = 0.90)$daily_drop_min
#> [1] 0.9
